role: XCTest suite for DataPurgeService ('Delete All My Data'): report booleans and summary copy, stubbed remote-deletion success/failure, conversation/facts/disclaimer clearing, container sweep of unknown files and directories, UserDefaults sweep with the entitlement/migration/AppleLanguages keep rules, biometric reset and iCloud sync left off. Each purge sweeps a temporary scope (temp directories, throwaway suites, temporary archive); a separate test pins that PurgeScope.device names the real containers and suites.
state: savedSettings: UserSettings? / savedDisclaimer: Bool (per-test restore of SettingsManager.shared)
lazy appSuite, groupSuite, containers, scope, archive (built from the per-instance root and suite names)
toplevel: Every purge call goes through purge(remoteDeleted:), which injects deleteRemote (no real CloudKit zone deletion) and the temporary scope.

flags.text: Every test runs the real DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData inside the app host. Files and preferences are swept in a temporary scope (temp directories and throwaway suites), but the steps that go through shared instances still act on the host: the AI-key Keychain items are removed, ConversationStore/UserFactsStore/assistant view model are cleared, CloudKitSyncManager.shared's local sync state is reset, the debug and crash logs, breadcrumbs and workout track backups are deleted, morning notifications cancelled, PendingEncryptionLedger cleared and UserDefaults.standard's assistant disclaimer key and units preference reset. Only settings and the disclaimer flag are restored, so later test classes in the process start with those cleared.

units.does: Opens the named UserDefaults suite; a name that cannot be opened stops the test run (preconditionFailure).

Per-test async setUp: snapshots SettingsManager.shared.settings and hasAcceptedDisclaimer, pins English, and creates the temporary container directories (group, applicationSupport, documents, caches, tmp) the test's purge scope sweeps.
Per-test async tearDown: restores the saved settings (when captured) and the disclaimer flag, removes both throwaway suites' persistent domains and the temporary directory (a missing one is ignored).

Runs DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData over this test's temporary scope (a temp directory per container, two throwaway suites) and temporary archive, with deleteRemote stubbed to `remoteDeleted`; the keychain, assistant stores, settings and CloudKit local state are still the shared instances.
